name: evaluate-sessions
message: [cron:evaluate-sessions] Evaluate unevaluated sessions.
description: Auto-evaluate completed sessions every 4 hours (JS handler)

name: system-status
message: [cron:system-status] Operational status check.
description: Operational status check every 4 hours (JS handler)

name: watchdog
message: [cron:watchdog] Check for stale sessions.
description: Cancel sessions stuck running > 30min (JS handler, 10min interval)

name: analyze-failures
message: [cron:analyze-failures] Analyze the last 10 evaluations in .state/evaluations/. Identify the top recurring pattern. Write findings to agents/bob/workspace/analysis.md. Compare recent evaluations against previous ones — did targeted fixes help? If same issue persists, recommend a different approach.
description: Bob analyzes evaluation patterns daily (detached agent process)

name: optimize
message: [cron:optimize] Read agents/bob/workspace/analysis.md and agents/optimizer/workspace/todo.md. Work on the top TODO item or top finding. Check for LLM-to-JS replacement opportunities. One fix per run.
description: Optimizer implements one fix per day (detached agent process)

name: coaching
message: [cron:coaching] Read agents/coach/workspace/todo.md. If there are pending items under # TODO (not # Tracking), work on the top item. You have subagents and can run exercises on other agents. One task per run. If TODO is empty, skip silently.
description: Coach drains todo.md every 48h (detached agent process)

name: lesson-consolidation
message: [cron:lesson-consolidation] Read all agents/*/knowledge/lessons.md files. Deduplicate, consolidate, remove stale entries. Preserve proven lessons.
description: Weekly lessons.md cleanup (detached agent process)

name: philosophy-check
message: [cron:philosophy-check] Check recent git commits (git log --since='24 hours ago' --oneline) for philosophy violations. Read agents/shared/philosophy.md, review changes. Write findings to agents/bob/workspace/philosophy-check.md.
description: RETIRED — low value (3.3 avg turns), Bob's heartbeat already covers philosophy. Disabled 2026-03-22.

name: heartbeat-bob
message: [heartbeat] Read your SOUL.md and workspace/todo.md. Pick the top unchecked item, do it, mark done. Then pick the next. Keep working until todo is empty or you run out of turns. When a design/review is complete and needs implementation, add a task to agents/may/workspace/todo.md: Review [design name] and implement if approved.
description: Bob's mission heartbeat — design reflection, todo drain, philosophy audit (30min)

name: heartbeat-optimizer
message: [heartbeat] Read your SOUL.md and heartbeat.md. Work through each section top to bottom.
description: Optimizer's mission heartbeat — find highest-impact improvement (24h)

name: heartbeat-coach
message: [heartbeat] Read your SOUL.md and heartbeat.md. Work through each section top to bottom.
description: Coach's mission heartbeat — plan training, review progress (48h)

name: heartbeat-evaluator
message: [heartbeat] Read your SOUL.md and heartbeat.md. Work through each section top to bottom.
description: Evaluator's mission heartbeat — review eval quality, calibrate (24h)

name: heartbeat-amy
message: [heartbeat] Read your SOUL.md and heartbeat.md. Work through each section top to bottom.
description: Amy's mission heartbeat — XHS exploration and insight synthesis (12h)

name: heartbeat-scout
message: [heartbeat] Read your SOUL.md and heartbeat.md. Work through each section top to bottom.
description: Scout's mission heartbeat — wide-net research and discovery (24h)

name: drain-todo
message: [cron:drain-todo] Drain todo items for may.
description: May self-drain: process todo.md items (JS handler, 4h)

name: optimizer-drain-todo
message: [cron:optimizer-drain-todo] Drain todo items for optimizer.
description: Optimizer drain: process todo.md items (JS handler, 4h)

name: amy-drain-todo
message: [cron:amy-drain-todo] Drain todo items for amy.
description: Amy drain: process todo.md items (JS handler, 4h)

name: coach-drain-todo
message: [cron:coach-drain-todo] Drain todo items for coach.
description: Coach drain: process todo.md items (JS handler, 4h)

name: scout-drain-todo
message: [cron:scout-drain-todo] Drain todo items for scout.
description: Scout drain: process todo.md items (JS handler, 4h)

name: heartbeat
message: [heartbeat] Read SOUL.md and workspace/todo.md. Check dispatched sessions (subagents.status). Check Bob's progress. Assign tasks to the right agent (bob=design, coder=code, optimizer=perf). Follow up failures. Then stop — stay idle and available for human.
description: May's captain heartbeat — health check, task follow-up, dispatch (30min)

name: focus-task-tracker
message: [cron:focus-task-tracker] Check active focus tasks for progress.
description: Track focus task progress every 8h — remind, check signals, escalate if stuck (JS handler)

name: daily-brief
message: [cron:daily-brief] Generate daily system brief.
description: Daily system metrics summary, emitted to Telegram (JS handler, 24h)
